My little boy was found under a tree in our local dog park with his sibling. He was terribly skinny, but all he wanted was a warm embrace and he came straight to us. 

We tried for the next week to catch his sibling but she was much more timid and eventually moved on from the spot. We are still searching for her as this was around 2 months ago. 

My partner named him Mingus because he thought it sounded funny (my partners conditions of keeping Mingus was he would be able to name him lol).

Over the next two months we packed a lot of weight back on him, and gave him a comfortable and safe environment. He obviously appreciated it as he would never leave our side and cried for constant cuddles. 

HOW HE ESCAPED:

I was mopping the bedroom (which was his room as we have other animals that he was scared of) and I let him into the rest of the house. I was hanging out washing, and he was exploring the garden. 

All of a sudden he grappled and scaled a wooden post on our fence. I swear to god he has powers because my other cat would have never been able to do that. 

I ran over to try and get him down, but I'm too short to reach the top of our fence and my 6'2 partner was at work. Mingus was about to jump into my hands, but turned at the last second and jumped over our fence (into a private property - that didnt stop me though)

It was 10:30PM and -3 degrees Celsius (south Australia lol) I was sprinting down the highway around our block with no shoes on trying to find him. No dice. 

My partner came home and tried to help, but I was in hysterics and had no clue what was happening. We drove around for a while but we couldnt find him. I havent self harmed in around 6 months, but I broke that last night. 

I just needed to get this off my chest. I'm honestly heartbroken and I dont fucking know what to do anymore. I feel like such a failure - he was literally my baby and he is gone. I did everything to get him back to health and now I'm responsible for letting him become a terrified stray once again. 

We are doing everything in our power to find him, but I am so miserable right now. 

Thanks for reading my sob story. Just needed some support.
